title: Connection Pooling with pgBouncer
description: Configure Prisma with pgBouncer for efficient connection pooling in production and serverless environments.

data.text: Connection pooling is critical for production PostgreSQL deployments. pgBouncer is a lightweight connection pooler that sits between Prisma Client and PostgreSQL, reducing the overhead of establishing new connections.

items: PostgreSQL connections are expensive to create
Serverless functions scale quickly and can exhaust database connections
pgBouncer reuses existing connections, reducing latency and resource usage

data.text: When using pgBouncer, configure your `DATABASE_URL` to point to the pgBouncer port (usually 6432) instead of PostgreSQL's default port (5432).

data.title: Note
data.text: When using pgBouncer in transaction pooling mode, prepared statements must be disabled in Prisma. Set `prepareStatement=false` in the connection string.
